summary: Nakamoto Inc. filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, reporting entry into a Second Addendum to its Warrant Agent Agreement removing VStock Transfer and appointing Odyssey Transfer and Trust as successor warrant agent under an Amended and Restated Warrant Agent Agreement. The change is administrative: Odyssey assumes no pre-existing liabilities, references in the warrants are re-pointed to Odyssey, and the agreement reflects the company's name change, Delaware conversion and 1-for-40 reverse stock split. No price, stake or premium is implicated. What to watch is purely operational — smooth transfer of warrant books and exercise mechanics for NAKA/NAKAW holders.
